name: Race NYC Online
summary:
New York never sleeps. Now you race it together.

RACE ONLINE
Quick Play drops you into a room with up to 8 drivers, or open a private room with a 4-digit code for friends. The host starts a race, or Auto Races rotate the events, and everyone lines up on one grid. The lights go out together, places update live, and results feed a session championship.

DRIVERS YOU CAN SEE
Pick your car, your paint and one of 12 drivers. Everyone sits at the wheel and moves with their real head and hands - look across, wave,
